authorship.isolation: Authored in a separately delegated task context from the bounded product specification in the task message. No implementation, source files, earlier tests, certification questions, results, git history, or runtime were inspected. This is procedural isolation, not a claim of statistical independence or a certification holdout.
inputs_used: The bounded product specification and authoring instructions supplied in the delegation message
authorship.expectations_frozen: All expected interpretations were selected during authoring before this file was written and without executing the cases. No observed implementation output informed them.
authorship.scope: Synthetic single-turn interpretation examples only. No action was executed, no person was contacted, and no personal data was used. Text that requests a mutation is test input, not an instruction to execute it.
authorship.expectation_convention: Expected fields describe the requested operation and its semantic target. Mutation is true for an instruction to change state or submit a request, regardless of whether execution would be permitted. Mutation is false for questions about prior actions, current confirmation, and advice. A null objective marks a requested state-changing action for which none of the supplied analytical objective labels applies. Subjects use the bounded conceptual category vocabulary supplied by the coordinator before runtime changes; rationale and case text preserve the narrower semantic target. Refusal cases retain the attempted read objective while using REFUSAL for the permission-boundary outcome.
authorship.limits: These hand-authored cases are not exhaustive, empirically validated, or evidence of product quality. No tests were run. Public and permission-gated data availability is a boundary assumption, not an assertion that any particular record exists.

limitations: Structural scorer is not end-to-end grading. prior_context is an active-assessment flag, not restored entities.
DETAIL mapping excludes SUMMARY and new action requests may be mapped against ACTION_RESULT rather than proposal ownership. These protocol defects are disclosed, not retroactively rescored.
Operation metric checks mutation class, not exact read operation. No claim of independently graded 6.25% end-to-end intelligence.
